action.objective: Broad search all legal White moves at depth 4 to identify safe, strong candidates after Black's Nh5.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search, so candidate_moves must be empty. I will spend up to 3000 nodes (half the total budget) to evaluate every legal root move at target depth 4, reserving the rest for single-candidate verification. Key concerns: White king on e2, Black queen on h3 and bishop on h2 give immediate threats; Black knight on h5 may hit f4/g3; White has no castling rights and c1 bishop is undeveloped. Need to find moves that address checks, pins, and tactical refutations rather than just shallow score.
